Other flags: ADM, AT, CF, CHP, CI, ER, ET, ETD. None likely.

But maybe "CI: Communication Inspecificity" - the description is about research for motion to compel, not a communication. So not.

"ER: Excessive Research" - research for motion to compel. But we don't know if it's excessive. No.

"ET: Excessive Time" - 0.5 hours each. Not.

"ETD: Embedded Time Discrepancy" - no embedded time.
